outcome.summary: The image-attachments epic is complete. A PNG or JPEG can be attached from a terminal or in the app, as attempt evidence or as a reference on a ticket, Kanban card or comment. Images are stored with the project data and shown as thumbnails with click-to-enlarge, labelled as evidence or reference, readable by workers, and checked on intake. Each criterion is evidenced in docs/verification/image-attachments/sprint-2/epic-outcome.md.
